title: Competitive intelligence
scope: Analyze Designrr, ZebraLearn, Automateed, Canva, Reedsy, Atticus, Gumroad/Payhip and other relevant tools. Evidence: official feature/pricing pages, dated screenshots where lawful, support docs, reviews, demos.
validation: Verify current prices and capabilities against primary sources; hands-on results only if actually tested.

title: Ebook content and visual quality
scope: What makes a paid educational ebook useful and professional: depth, exercises, diagrams, cover, hierarchy, typography, layout, accessibility, PDF/EPUB. Evidence: legally accessible samples, design guidelines, rendering experiments.
validation: Human rubric review; do not claim access to paid books or copy proprietary layouts.

human_tasks.task: Human review of the ebook quality rubric

title: Customer demand and niches
scope: Buyer segments for ebooks and SaaS, jobs-to-be-done, demand, competing offers, objections, niche opportunities. Evidence: search intent, public demand signals, interviews only if actually conducted.
validation: Do not equate search volume or AI opinion with willingness to pay.

title: Sales and marketing
scope: Landing pages, Meta/Instagram/Google ads, email funnels, previews, checkout, delivery, attribution, refunds, measurement. Evidence: platform policies, official docs, observed funnels.
validation: Ad economics are assumptions until real campaigns give data; no ad spending.

title: AI and technical feasibility
scope: Structured ebook pipeline, model gateway, chapter generation, sources, editing, assets, PDF/EPUB, background jobs, retries, data model. Evidence: official SDK/framework docs, benchmarks, small approved prototypes in 01-research/poc/.
validation: Runnable tests for key claims; label untested integrations as hypotheses.

title: Business and unit economics
scope: Model ebook revenue and SaaS revenue separately: prices, AI tokens, GPU/API usage, fees, refunds, hosting, support, acquisition, margins.
validation: Recalculate formulas independently; separate observed figures from illustrative values.

title: Legal, trust and compliance
scope: Copyright, AI authorship, source/image licenses, privacy, payments, tax, consumer refunds, platform ad policies, security. Evidence: authoritative laws, provider terms, platform policies.
validation: Not professional legal advice; legal/security findings get elevated owner review.

human_tasks.task: Owner review of the legal and compliance risk register

title: Agentic SDLC
scope: Specification-first engineering, agent workflows, code review, tests, tool portability, multi-developer coordination. Evidence: user-provided references plus authoritative tool docs.
validation: Separate opinions from verified tool capabilities; test automation locally.

title: Research verification and QA
scope: Verify consequential claims from R1-R8; track contradictions, freshness, source integrity, decision traceability.
validation: A second AI review alone is NOT independent verification; block unsupported critical decisions.

human_tasks.task: Human spot-check of a sample of verified critical claims

title: Portable knowledge and agent collaboration
scope: Two-repo contracts, hierarchical indexes, phase prompts, multi-agent task ownership, Git policies, progress gates, knowledge backporting.
validation: Test missing links, false completion, stale references, task synchronization.
